gatoh.graphs.graphs.GraphEdge

class GraphEdge(hierarchy: str, from_node: int, to_node: int, weighting: float = 0.0, rw_params: tuple[float, float] | None = None)[source]

A helper class that allows rustworx to more efficiently store information about Agent relationships in the graph edges. As the social hierarchies are assumed to be DiGraphs, each GraphEdge is directional, and the social weighting that Agent A places on Agent B will not necessarilly be equally reciprocated.

Parameters:

  • hierarchy (str) – The name of the social hierarchy that this edge belongs to.

  • from_node (int) – The index of the origin node.

  • to_node (int) – The index of the destination node.

  • weighting (float, optional) – The relationship opinion value that is being assigned (range [-1, 1]).

  • rw_params (tuple[float, float], optional) – The normal distribution (mean, variance) to assign for relationship-specific random walk effects.
